tasks.query: 创 造 与 魔 法
tasks.query_intent: User is searching for 创造与魔法 (Creation and Magic), a sandbox survival crafting mobile game with building and magic elements.

evidence.note: 创造与魔法 is a fantasy sandbox survival crafting game; 明日之后 is NetEase's post-apocalyptic survival shooter.

tasks.relationship_analysis: Both are major Chinese mobile survival games but differ in theme (fantasy sandbox vs zombie apocalypse) while sharing the survival genre.
tasks.comment: [Query Intent] The query "创 造 与 魔 法" indicates the user wants the Creation and Magic sandbox survival crafting game with building and magic mechanics. [Ad Analysis] The advertised app "明日之后" is NetEase's post-apocalyptic open-world survival mobile game. [Relevance Breakdown] Both are prominent survival-genre mobile games; players searching for one survival title often explore other major alternatives in the same broad category even though the themes differ. [Why not higher/lower] Not Excellent because it is a different game IP and theme; not Acceptable because the survival gameplay genre overlap is strong enough that users would likely consider it. Rated Good.
